title: Tensor Product Lattice Function
body_html:
Tensor Product Lattice Function

This is the shared foundation layer node for tensor-product lattice functions. It should be used by both epipelagic and supercuspidal nodes instead of the older epipelagic_theta.tensor_product_lattice_function.

Given lattice functions \(L\) on \(V\) and \(L'\) on \(V'\), their tensor product lattice function on \(W=V\otimes_D V'\) is \[ (L\otimes L')_t=\sum_{r+r'=t} L_r\otimes_{o_D}L'_{r'}. \] Its jump set satisfies \[ \operatorname{Jump}(L\otimes L')=\operatorname{Jump}(L)+\operatorname{Jump}(L'). \]

For building points \(x\in B(G)\) and \(x'\in B(G')\), this construction gives the lattice function \(B_{x,x'}=L_x\otimes L_{x'}\) used in the generalized lattice model of the oscillator representation.
